name: portal.upb.edu.co
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: portal.upb.edu.co scores 72 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Form elements must have labels
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /tecnicas-tecnologias, /pregrados, for example #by40q-nav-toggle. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 10 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /tecnicas-tecnologias, /apoyo-financiero/becas-estudiantes, /apoyo-financiero/beneficios-economicos-para-estudiantes, /apoyo-financiero/convenios-beneficios-corporativos and 6 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they…
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies _parsely_session, _parsely_visitor.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

fix.title: 6 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Large images are served as WebP, AVIF or SVG
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
